A high-speed rollover, hydrocodone in his pocket, and a refused chemical test end in a quiet courtroom deal.

PGA Tiger Woods Plea Deal Florida DUI License Suspension Reckless Driving

The Unavoidable Truth: Woods avoided a DUI conviction despite a rollover crash and refusing a chemical test.

The Unavoidable Lie: The five-year suspension represents an exceptionally harsh or unprecedented punishment.
